title: Diagnostic Case Laboratory
level: Plant Health, IPM & Biosecurity Specialist / advanced specialization development
intendedAudience: Learners completing the Plant Health, IPM & Biosecurity Specialist pathway
Cultivation personnel expected to integrate scouting, disease/pest evidence, biosecurity, IPM, CAPA and professional handoff in complex cases
prerequisites: Completion of PHIB Courses 1-6 or equivalent advanced plant-health/IPM/biosecurity preparation
evidencePolicy: Case conclusions must trace to governed source-backed observations and explicit reasoning. Learners must distinguish observation, context, hypothesis, test evidence, control action, authority and residual uncertainty. Visual pattern recognition alone is insufficient for high-consequence diagnoses.
assessmentPolicy: The case laboratory and dedicated assessment remain development-only until human technical review, assessor calibration, accessibility review and pilot evidence are complete. Case success does not grant laboratory, pesticide, quarantine-release, destruction or regulated product-disposition authority.
description: Integrates the specialist pathway through structured plant-health cases requiring evidence intake, differential diagnosis, targeted confirmation, containment, control selection, CAPA/recovery planning and defensible written/verbal handoff.
learningOutcomes: Convert a mixed plant-health case file into a structured evidence set that separates direct observations, contextual facts, test results, assumptions and missing information.
Build and revise a differential diagnosis using supporting, conflicting and discriminating evidence across biotic, abiotic, root-zone, environmental and process explanations.
Select proportionate next observations, samples, tests and containment actions that reduce uncertainty while preserving safety, identity and authority boundaries.
Integrate IPM, biosecurity and CAPA into a case response that links the likely failure mechanism to controls, recovery metrics and effectiveness checks.
Defend a final specialist case recommendation through a reconstructable written record and concise handoff that communicates confidence, residual uncertainty and escalation needs.
